description:
The server crate's tests build their repository from a fixture that declares a taxonomy, so the HTTP surface's tests do not depend on the binary supplying one.

## Background

The server crate builds test repositories the same way, and one of its route tests asserts on the taxonomy the endpoint answers with. It is a separate crate with its own test target and its own fixture module, so adopting the shared fixture there is separate work from adopting it inside the library.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The server crate's test repositories are built from a fixture that declares a type hierarchy explicitly.
- [hard] REQ-02: The route test that asserts on the hierarchy the endpoint answers with reads its expectation from that fixture rather than from a shipped default.
- [hard] REQ-03: No server test constructs the scaffold's hierarchy template to obtain a taxonomy.
- [hard] REQ-04: The server suites pass unchanged.

## Notes

The server crate consumes the library's fixture rather than declaring a second one, so one vocabulary serves both crates' assertions.
title: Adopt the taxonomy fixture in the server crate
